name: pawmate
description: PawMate: connects busy pet owners with trusted pet walkers (frontend + backend)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
